text: A repository's touched parts are checked by their own declared commands, offline, in their prepared environments (#484, step 3 of #452's plan). The factory selects parts from the planned files, acceptance files and admitted regressions by the captured ownership, and prepares their dependencies first. It then runs each part's format, lint, build and test, in that order, in one disposable container per part, driven from the watcher in Go, so an image needn't hold Python, with no host cache and no network. Results are reported by part and phase; every failing phase fails the check, and a formatting command must fail on differences. All parts share today's twelve-minute run and ten-minute test budget, and #487 will let a part declare more. The builder's test tool and the factory's final check use the same execution through the check queue. The merger switched the checks' container to #485's root-owned copy, which this build predates, and ran a real Go part's format, lint, build and test through it against the pinned golang image. Nothing runs on another repository until the plan's last step.
